control.label: control
control.method: Frozen control 0b07410 versus bounded retained-history admission, candidate first. Receipt-only deferral keeps the original command/input/deadline and obtains fresh authority before any callback; no mutation retry is added. Same per-reply eight-frame transport window, archive batch size two, four archive-cut slots, 256-MiB admission budget and 4096-entry cap. Three pinned 1-vCPU/3-GiB nodes, 1500 three-voter groups, 500 leaders/1000 followers each; four SQL workers/64 reservations; 24 writers, two 180-second windows. Fresh persistent internal node data and unchanged external RustFS backing, cold VM each cohort. No timed retries. Exact 4500 replicas/1500 archives, all errors retained. Boundary host/compiler/VM CPU observations. No builds, profiling or preservation by this task during timing. All artifacts retained; historical cohorts relocated with verified content/metadata and original volume paths before both runs. Closed historical Raft logs were losslessly compressed and verified before this pair.

method_limits: Candidate first; reversed confirmation remains outstanding.
Successful latencies exclude refused requests; any timed error fails qualification.
Operation durations overlap and are not additive client latency components.
